description: The select, rich-select and textarea editors of the Svelte 5 data grid, plus a custom cellEditor snippet for the cases no built-in fits. editorType: 'select' is a native dropdown, 'rich-select' a combobox with typeahead search and 'textarea' a multi-line editor where Enter inserts a newline. The Severity column supplies its own range slider as a cellEditor snippet that receives the value plus commit and cancel callbacks.

faq.question: How do I write my own cell editor?
faq.answer: Pass a snippet as the column's cellEditor. It receives the current value and commit and cancel functions; render any control you like and call commit with the new value. The Severity column here uses a range slider.

faq.question: What is the difference between select and rich-select?
faq.answer: select renders a native <select> with the editorOptions; rich-select renders a combobox with typeahead, which is the better choice when the option list is long.

faq.question: How does the textarea editor commit?
faq.answer: Enter inserts a newline; Tab, Escape and blur end the edit, so a long description gets a proper multi-line editor without leaving the grid.
